entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, and you've reached VeloFit Customer Support. How can I help you today?
Finally! I want to return this pathetic jersey I bought. This is completely unacceptable!
I'm certainly sorry to hear you're not happy with your purchase. I can help you with that. Can you please provide me with your order number?
It's VF-987654. And you better help me. The jersey is the wrong size. It's way too tight, I can barely breathe in it. I've never had this problem before. It's a joke.
Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Line jersey, delivered on October 3rd. That was about 84 days ago.
And?! Your website says 90 days! Are you trying to get out of this? Because I swear, I will file a chargeback and I want to speak to your manager right now! This is ridiculous service!

Not at all, sir. I was just confirming the details. You are absolutely correct, and you are well within our 90-day return window. I can process this for you right away. Would you like a full refund, or would you prefer an exchange for a larger size?
Oh. Well... No, I don't want an exchange. I'll just get my money back. Your sizing is clearly a mess.

I understand. I have just authorized the return and a pre-paid shipping label has been sent to the email address on your account. Just send the jersey back in its original packaging, and we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method once we receive it. Is there anything else I can assist with?
No. That's it. Make sure it gets done.
It will be. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
